# KNGHT

> KNGHT is a brand worldbuilding studio in Toronto, Ontario. It builds complete brand worlds for regulated consumer businesses: clinics, medspas, law firms, spirits, coffee and food. A world covers the name, the rules, the voice, the site, the space, the print and the systems that run it, all written inside the rules of the category. KNGHT is a Sergio Ho studio.

KNGHT works where one wrong word can cost a licence and one weak launch can cost a year. Every world KNGHT sells, it has built and run itself first.

## The seven layers

Each world is built in this order. No layer is built before Lore.

1. Lore: who you are, who you stand against, and what you are called. The brief and the codex every other layer reads from.
2. Law: what you can say, what you can charge, and how it is packaged. Offers and claims checked against your regulator.
3. Language: voice, hooks, content and ads, written to stop the scroll and pass review.
4. Map: site, search and AI visibility. Where people find your world and how they enter it.
5. Ground: the physical space. Arrival, flow, signage and the screens on your walls.
6. Artifacts: print, labels, packaging and forms. Everything a customer holds.
7. Machinery: intake, booking, follow-up and reporting. The systems that keep the world running without you.

## Three ways to work with KNGHT

- The Verdict (fixed fee): a scored audit of an existing brand world. Every layer is judged against the buyer and the regulator, with a ranked fix list and the order to do it in. Every engagement starts here.
- The Build (scoped by layer): a complete world from zero, or the missing layers, delivered ready to launch.
- The Keep (monthly): KNGHT runs the world after launch, including content, signage, campaigns, new locations and new products.

## Worlds built and run by KNGHT

- Restoration Medical (healthcare): physician-led clinics in Thornhill and Woodbridge, built across five service lines.
- Black Lotus Coffee (food and beverage): a coffee house built as a place people return to.
- Castleblack Spirits (beverage alcohol): a ready-to-drink rum with a castle's worth of lore.
- Toronto Beauty (aesthetics): one aesthetics standard across a GTA network of providers.
- [Lorelyns Gourmet Desserts](https://lorelyns.com/) (allergen-friendly food): nut free, gluten free, plant-based desserts.
- [Rum Raiders Ring](https://rumraider.com/) (beverage alcohol): premium rum RTDs and spirits, poured in bars and stores across Ontario.
- [Lisa Dang Immigration Law](https://lisadanglaw.com/) (legal services): a boutique immigration practice where every file is handled by the lawyer, start to finish.
